steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each benchmark is placed by its sample size against the minimum of ten and the source of its percentile.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Benchmark sample below ten
findings.fix: Widen the match or report it as indicative

findings.title: Percentile with no source
findings.fix: Name the survey the percentile comes from

outcome.notChecked: Market changes after the survey date.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] role-b-benchmark.md:12  Benchmark sample below ten.
       Fix: Widen the match or report it as indicative.
[medium] survey-sample.csv:19  Percentile with no source.
       Fix: Name the survey the percentile comes from.
[low] match-quality.md:26  Match with no sample size.
       Fix: Add the sample size.
Not checked: Market changes after the survey date.
pros: Checks a match with no sample size, a sample below the minimum (default 10), and a percentile with no source.
cons: Not checked: Market changes after the survey date.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-salary-benchmark skill on the records for this review.
